additional_info.subject: RE: 0384647 - ID0384647-DC/Si-D/FR- [ MP / P8 170000883] Frozen Screen, screen does not react CRM:02023000198
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
we have case regarding the screen frozen and screen not responding from Engie.
we have checked the charger via remote access, and we have found that the touch controller is accessible, I recommend the following steps for further on-site performance.
1.check if cable is properly inserted, remove and insert again -> try again screen
2. Check with another USB Cable
Please note that if the site is far from your location, we recommend bringing a spare HMI screen in case the troubleshooting steps do not resolve the issue.
Additionally, please notify us two days in advance before scheduling any site intervention. This will allow us to remotely access the charger and offer support if needed.
